The repeated η*=−i(det A−4)/(4α) must obey the source inverse ζ admissibility (η nonreal and prescribed sign). z=m(η²+1)/(η²−1) is locally conformal there because z′=−4mη/(η²−1)²≠0. The source geometric-multiplicity theorem isolates A=diag(α,−4/α) as semisimple double; all other admissible repeated roots are defective Jordan EP2. Expanding exact quadratic roots along Δ′≠0 gives coefficient −mη*/[α*(η*²−1)²] sqrt(−Δ(s)). α=0 otherwise linear unless excluded flooding.
